scope: Benchmark and qualification evidence for the initial Flint integration.

benchmarks-2026-10-23.scope: Complete card: single-ar d0-131072, multi-ar C1/2/4/6/8, cold loading at capacity 262144, both memory rows; Gufo and llama.cpp.
benchmarks-2026-10-23.measurement: One warmed sample per point, greedy seed 1, HTTP on both sides, fresh server per sweep/concurrency. Artifacts carry source buildMode 'nix-release' because the driver hard-codes it; the actual build is the non-Nix release preset recorded under 'gufo'.

conditions.powerProfile: performance (power-profiles-daemon, amd_pstate; no ACPI platform profile)

benchmarks-2026-10-23.loadingMethod: POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED on the GGUF before each launch; mincore verified zero resident pages. Runtime libraries may be warm.
benchmarks-2026-10-23.quality: Prompt/cache counts identical across servers (d131072 frontier one token apart). Completion hashes cover reasoning, NUL and content: all 63 Gufo C1-C8 completions match Gufo C1, which equals the Gufo single-user d0 completion.

concurrencyRefresh.reason: Reasoning-aware completion hashes; first single-cohort rerun differed from the sweep by up to 8% on llama.cpp C2, so three cohorts per point.

singleUserRefresh.reason: Reasoning-aware completion hashes in every retained artifact.
